key_notes: Key 1 (t=2.59s): Initial archival pose of compass; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=3.71s): Mid-sequence articulation of compass; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=4.95s): Peak dynamic extension of compass over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=6.19s): Follow-through and settle of compass with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of compass (2.59s..6.19s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
